answer_text: Vodafone Cash in Egypt had 8.2 million active users, with 2.8 million added during the year.
Business deposits of £5.4 billion were roughly equal to (about 100% of) the total customer funds of £5,290.5m held at 31 March 2024.

Zalando - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (prior year auditor: EY GmbH & Co. KG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Stuttgart)
Delivery Hero - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin

Yes, both companies used the same auditor, KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin, for their 2024 financial statements. For Zalando, KPMG was new in 2024 (the prior year auditor was EY); the evidence does not state whether KPMG was new for Delivery Hero in 2024.
